verses.text: A prayer of David. LORD, hear my fair request. Listen to my prayer, which comes from lips that do not lie.
Let my judgment come from you. Let your eyes see what is fair.
You have tested my heart. You have checked on me in the night. You have examined me and found nothing wrong. I have decided that my mouth will not sin.
As for what other people do, I have followed what you said and kept away from the ways of violent people.
My steps have stayed on your paths. My feet have not slipped.
I call to you, God, because you will answer me. Turn your ear to me and hear what I say.
Show me your amazing, faithful love. With your right hand you save those who come to you for safety from their enemies.
Protect me as you would protect your own eyes. Hide me in the shadow of your wings
from the wicked people who attack me, from my deadly enemies who surround me.
Their hearts are hard and unfeeling. Their mouths speak proud words.
They have tracked us down and surrounded us. Their eyes watch for a chance to throw us to the ground.
They are like a lion hungry for its prey, like a young lion hiding in wait.
Get up, LORD! Face them and bring them down! Use your sword to rescue me from the wicked.

LORD, use your hand to rescue me from such people, people of this world whose reward is in this life only. You fill the stomachs of those you treasure. Their children have plenty, and they store up wealth for their own children.
But because I have done what is right, I will see your face. When I wake up, I will be satisfied to see you.
